principles: Preserve the instrumentation guard as a finite fail-closed budget.
Base the ceiling change on measured historical and current repository inventory.
Keep the Dynamic Finding document and unrelated runtime behavior outside this corrective Story.
drivers: The clean main baseline now produces 804 builds while the existing ceiling is 800.
Historical measurement at commit 0abf3d859d produced 796 builds with ceiling 800.
Synthetic builds remain 419; repository-backed builds increased from 377 to 385 through eight identified source files.

options.name: Measured fixed headroom at 808
pros: Accepts the explained eight-build inventory growth
cons: A legitimate fifth additional binding requires a deliberate update

options.name: Broader ceiling at 820
cons: Introduces sixteen builds of unexplained headroom
Weakens the guard beyond historical behavior

options.name: Remove or unbound the assertion
cons: Cannot detect runaway dynamic binding work

rationale: The current count is 804 and the last known-good baseline was 796 under an 800 ceiling. Eight identified repository files account exactly for the increase while synthetic work is unchanged, so 808 preserves the original four-build safety margin without hiding future growth.

preMortem.scenario: The measured count grows again for a legitimate source addition.
preMortem.trigger: The smoke reports 809 or more builds.
preMortem.mitigation: Re-measure synthetic and repository components, identify each inventory delta, and update the bound only with recorded evidence.

preMortem.scenario: The ceiling is widened or comparator weakened to make the test green.
preMortem.trigger: Mutation makes a count above the ceiling pass.
preMortem.consequence: The instrumentation regression guard becomes ineffective.
preMortem.mitigation: Run executable comparator and sentinel-ceiling mutants plus built-in boundary self-characterization.

preMortem.trigger: Only source or only dist is changed.
preMortem.mitigation: Require clean rebuild and fail-closed source/dist binding mutation checks.

preMortem.scenario: The corrective Story changes the Dynamic Finding decision document.
preMortem.trigger: The protected document appears in the diff.
preMortem.consequence: The audit-only Story scope and evidence are contaminated.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the document protected in scope contract and execute a protected-document mutation probe.
